blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a widely used approach for grounding large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge. However, configuring a pipeline is an expensive hyperparameter optimization problem over many interacting choices, from chunking and embedding model to reranking and generation. Existing optimizers, from greedy search to Bayesian optimization, reduce each trial to an aggregate score and search without modeling why a configuration performed as it did, even though the retrieved chunks already provide evidence about whether each failure occurred during retrieval or after it. We introduce Agentic AutoRAG, an LLM-agent optimizer for multi-objective RAG hyperparameter optimization with retrieval-versus-generation failure attribution. It proposes configurations scored on a frozen exam from the corpus: after each trial a Diagnoser attributes each failed question to retrieval or generation, and a Proposer, grounded in a knowledge base of model rankings and pricing, selects the next configuration, weighing accuracy against cost to trace a Pareto frontier. On three multi-hop QA benchmarks it reaches higher LLM-judge accuracy than every baseline we compare, and within its first 10 trials it matches or beats the statistical baselines’ full 30-trial judge accuracy. In its cost-aware mode on a real-world healthcare corpus it reaches a median exam accuracy of 77%, above the strongest baseline’s 71.5%, at about 58% of that baseline’s cost per query, and it matches that 71.5% at about 22% of the cost. 1 1 1 Code: https://github.com/Agentic-Systems-Lab/Agentic-AutoRAG

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a standard way to ground large language models (LLMs) in knowledge beyond their training data ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) . Configuring a RAG pipeline means choosing across many interacting dimensions: chunking, embedding model, index type, retrieval depth, reranker, query expansion, passage compression, and generator. These choices are coupled and should not be tuned in isolation ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . The best retrieval depth, for instance, depends on chunk size: small chunks each hold less text, so they need a deeper retrieval to surface the same evidence that a few large chunks already contain. The best configuration also shifts from corpus to corpus: a pipeline tuned for one can underperform on another, so the search must be repeated for each new one ( Kartal et al., 2025 ; Orbach et al., 2026 ) . Scoring a configuration means running the whole pipeline over a test set, so the search must be sample-efficient.
blocks.zh: 检索增强的生成(RAG)已成为一种标准方式,用以在知识中将大型语言模型(LLM)打入其培训数据之外(Lewis等,2020;Gao等,2023). 配置RAG管道意味着在许多相互作用的维度上作出选择:块化、嵌入模型、索引类型、检索深度、重排、查询扩展、通道压缩和生成器。 这些选择是相互结合的,不应孤立地加以调整(Wang等,2024.). 例如,最佳的检索深度取决于块大小:小块每个所持有的文字较少,因此它们需要更深的检索,以显示一些大块已经包含的同样证据。 最佳的配置也从官能团转向官能团:为一个人调节的管道在另一个管道上可能表现不佳,因此每个新的管道必须重复搜索(Kartal等,2025;Orbach等,2026)。 扫描一个配置意味着整个管道运行在一个测试集上,因此搜索必须具有样本效率.

blocks.en: Recent work applies general-purpose search algorithms to this problem: AutoRAG’s greedy node-wise selection ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , multi-armed bandits ( Fu et al., 2024 ) , Bayesian optimization ( Conway et al., 2025 ; Barker et al., 2025 ) , and genetic search ( Kartal et al., 2025 ) . All of these optimizers reduce each trial to an aggregate score and search the space without modeling why a configuration performed as it did. When a configuration scores low, they cannot tell whether retrieval and reranking failed to surface the relevant passages, or the generator answered incorrectly despite having the right context. However, any RAG pipeline already records which chunks it retrieved. By checking whether the passages that contain the answer (the gold spans) appear among them, we can attribute each failure to retrieval or generation. We are not aware of prior RAG optimizers that use this per-question failure evidence to drive their configuration proposals.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作将通用搜索算法应用于这一问题: AutoRAG贪婪的节点选择(Kim等,2024年),多武装强盗(Fu等,2024年),巴耶斯优化(Conway等,2025年;Barker等,2025年),和基因搜索(Kartal等,2025年). 所有这些优化器都将每个试卷降为总分并搜索空间,而没有模拟为何一个配置像它那样进行. 当一个配置得分较低时,他们无法分辨检索和再排序是否未能出出相关段落,或者尽管有正确的上下文,生成器还是答错. 然而,任何RAG管道都已经记录了它检索到的块。 通过检查包含答案的段落(黄金跨度)是否在其中出现,我们可以将每次失败归咎于检索或生成. 我们不知道之前的RAG优化器会使用这种每个问题的证据来推动他们的配置建议.

blocks.en: We introduce Agentic AutoRAG, a reasoning-driven optimizer for RAG pipelines. Like recent LLM-agent optimizers for general hyperparameter tuning ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Trirat et al., 2025 ) , it uses a language model to propose configurations, but specializes this approach to RAG and cost-aware search. It contributes three ideas:
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Agentic AutoRAG,一个推理驱动的RAG管道优化器. 和最近用于一般超参数调取调取的LLM-Agent优化器(Liu等,2025;Trirat等,2025)一样,它使用语言模型提出配置,但专门采用这种方法来进行RAG和成本意识搜索. 它提出了三个想法:

blocks.en: 1. A diagnose-then-propose loop. After each trial, a Diagnoser reads the per-question failure evidence, attributes each failure to retrieval or generation, and compresses it into a short diagnosis. A Proposer then reads that diagnosis and selects the next configuration. 2. A knowledge-base-grounded, cost-aware agent. The Proposer prices and ranks candidate configurations against public model leaderboards and per-token pricing before spending a trial on them, so it navigates the accuracy-cost trade-off without first learning which models are strong or cheap from trial outcomes. 3. A corpus-derived exam. Adapting established corpus-grounded exam generation ( Guinet et al., 2024 ; Shashidhar et al., 2025 ) , we draft open-ended, multi-hop questions with verbatim gold-answer spans, filter them through a sufficiency oracle, and keep only questions that separate configurations spanning the search space. The exam is frozen once and reused as the optimization target across every trial.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 RAG pipeline optimization
blocks.zh: 2.1 RAG管道优化

blocks.en: A RAG pipeline exposes many discrete choices, making its configuration a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) problem with an expensive black-box objective.
blocks.zh: 一个RAG管道暴露出许多离散的选择,使得其配置成为具有昂贵的黑箱目标的一个超参数优化(HPO)问题.

blocks.en: AutoRAG ( Kim et al., 2024 ) decomposes the pipeline into modular nodes and greedily selects the best module at each node in pipeline order. AutoRAG-HP ( Fu et al., 2024 ) casts RAG tuning as a multi-armed bandit problem and tunes three hyperparameters with a hierarchical UCB1 variant. syftr ( Conway et al., 2025 ) applies multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MO-TPE) to a large space of RAG pipelines, from standard to agentic, with a Pareto-Pruner that halts candidates unlikely to extend the frontier and a transfer step that seeds a new search with configurations found on other datasets. Barker et al. (2025) add more objectives, tuning cost, latency, safety, and alignment jointly with multi-objective Bayesian optimization. RAGSmith ( Kartal et al., 2025 ) searches RAG compositions with a genetic algorithm. Orbach et al. (2026) compare TPE, random search, and greedy variants and find that about 10 trials reach the accuracy of an exhaustive grid, though over a space of only 162 configurations, far smaller than the one we search.
blocks.zh: AutoRAG (Kim等, 2024年)将管道分解为模块化节点并贪婪地在管道顺序中选择每个节点的最佳模块. AutoRAG-HP (Fu等,2024年)将RAG调子铸成多臂强盗问题并用分级的UCB1变体来调取三个超参数. syftr(Conway等,2025年)将多目标巴耶斯优化(MO-TPE)应用到从标准到代理的大面积RAG管道上,并配有Pareto-Pruner来阻止候选人不太可能扩展边疆,以及一个转接步骤,以其他数据集所发现的配置来种子新的搜索. Barker等人(2025年)增加了更多的目标,调试成本,耐久性,安全性,以及配合多目标的贝叶斯优化. RAGSMith(Kartal等,2025年)用基因算法搜索RAG的成分. Orbach等人(2026年)比较了TPE,随机搜索,和贪婪的变体,发现大约10个试验达到了一个详尽网格的精确度,尽管在只有162个配置的空间上,远比我们搜索的要小.

blocks.en: All of these methods reduce a trial to its score and do not model why a configuration failed, which is the per-question evidence our optimizer diagnoses after each trial to guide its next proposal.
blocks.zh: 所有这些方法都将一个试验降低到它的分数,并且不模拟一个配置失败的原因,这就是我们每次试验后最优化的诊断,以指导其下一个提议。

blocks.en: 2.2 LLM agents as optimizers
blocks.zh: 2.2 LLM 剂作为优化器

blocks.en: A parallel line of work uses an LLM as the optimizer itself, though not yet applied to RAG pipeline configuration. OPRO ( Yang et al., 2024 ) gives the model a meta-prompt that lists the solutions tried so far with their scores and asks it to propose a better one, shown on tasks such as linear regression and prompt optimization.
blocks.zh: 一条平行的工作线使用LLM作为优化器本身,虽然尚未应用于RAG管线配置. OPRO(Yang等,2024年)给予模型一个元时速,列出迄今为止用分数尝试的解决方案,并请求其提出更好的解决方案,显示在线性回归和即时优化等任务上.

blocks.en: In HPO specifically, Liu et al. (2025) introduce AgentHPO, a two-agent framework where a Creator proposes hyperparameters and an Executor runs experiments across 12 ML tasks. Trirat et al. (2025) apply LLM agents to a broader range of AutoML tasks.
blocks.zh: 具体在HPO中,由刘等(2025年)介绍代理人. HPO是一个双剂框架,一个创建者提出超参数,一个执行者在12个ML任务中进行实验. Trirat等 (2025)将LLM代理应用于范围更广的AutoML任务.

blocks.en: These optimizers are general-purpose and single-objective, and they carry no prior about which models are strong or cheap. We specialize the approach to RAG pipeline configuration, and we ground the agent in a knowledge base of public model rankings and per-token pricing so it can weigh accuracy against cost and rule out configurations before running them.
blocks.zh: 这些优化器是通用的和单一的客观的,它们没有事先携带哪个型号很强或便宜. 我们专门研究RAG管道配置的方法,我们把代理商放在公共模型排名和每盘价格的知识库中,以便它能够权衡准确性与成本,排除配置后再运行.

blocks.en: A separate line of work builds agentic RAG systems, where an agent decides what to retrieve while answering each question ( Asai et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Leng et al., 2025 ; Singh et al., 2025 ) . Our agent instead tunes the pipeline configuration rather than answering questions itself.
blocks.zh: 单独的一行工作建立了代理RAG系统,由代理商在回答每个问题时决定回收内容(Asai等,2024;Yu等,2024;Wu等,2025;Leng等,2025;Singh等,2025)。 我们的代理人转而调整管道配置,而不是自己回答问题。

blocks.en: 2.3 Automated RAG evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.3 自动RAG评价

blocks.en: Building an evaluation set from the target corpus is an established way to assess retrieval-augmented systems without hand annotation ( Guinet et al., 2024 ; Saad-Falcon et al., 2024 ; Shashidhar et al., 2025 ; Filice et al., 2025 ) . Closest to us, Guinet et al. (2024) prompt an LLM to write corpus-grounded multiple-choice questions and use item response theory to discard questions that do not separate systems. Our exam adapts this recipe for configuration search: the questions are open-ended with verbatim gold spans, and we keep only those that separate configurations spanning our search space.
blocks.zh: 从目标体中建立一套评价是评估无人工注释的检索增强系统的一种既定方法(Guinet等,2024;Saad-Falcon等,2024;Shashidhar等,2025;Filice等,2025)。 最贴近我们,Guinet等人(2024年)促使一个LLM写出被命题所基于的多选择问题,并使用项目响应理论来丢弃不分离系统的问题. 我们的考试适应了这个配置搜索的配方: 问题是开放式的, 并且是金字塔, 我们只保留那些 跨越我们搜索空间的配置。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Agentic AutoRAG is a reasoning-driven optimizer for RAG pipelines. Each trial runs a candidate configuration on a frozen exam of question-answer pairs, and a two-stage reasoning loop interprets the result. A Diagnoser interprets per-question failure evidence from the trial that just ran, and a Proposer selects the next configuration based on the diagnosis. The optimizer searches over answer accuracy and cost per query and produces a Pareto frontier of non-dominated configurations. Figure 1 gives an overview.
blocks.zh: Agentic AutoRAG是RAG管线的推理驱动优化器. 每场审判在被冻结的问答对等考试中运行一个候选配置,一个两阶段推理循环来解释结果. 一个诊断者从刚刚运行的试验中解析出每个问题失败的证据,一个提议者根据诊断选择下一个配置. 优化器搜索高于回答准确度和每个查询的成本,并生成非主导配置的Pareto前沿. 图1概述了情况。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Architecture of Agentic AutoRAG. The exam generation pipeline builds a frozen exam from the corpus once before optimization: TF-IDF neighborhoods seed the Composer, which drafts open-ended questions with verbatim gold spans, validation filters and a sufficiency oracle enforce answerability and multi-hop dependence, and probe-based discrimination admits only questions that differentiate across the search space. The optimization loop alternates between a Diagnoser, which compresses each trial’s per-question failure evidence, and a Proposer, which selects the next configuration grounded in a knowledge base of public model rankings and pricing. The optimizer outputs a Pareto frontier over accuracy and cost, a recommended configuration, and a per-trial reasoning trace.
blocks.zh: 图1:Agentic AutoRAG的架构. 考试生成管道在优化前从主体中构建了一次被冻结的考试:TF-IDF街区为作曲家的种子,其起草的无限制问题有逐字记录黄金跨度,验证过滤器和充足甲骨文执行可回答性和多跳依赖性,基于探测的歧视只承认不同搜索空间的问题. 最佳循环替补在“诊断者”和“投标者”之间,后者根据公共模型排名和定价的知识基础来选择下一个配置。 优化器输出一个Pareto前沿的精度和成本,一个推荐的配置,以及每一次的推理跟踪.

blocks.en: 3.2 Exam Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 考试生成

blocks.en: Our framework builds an open-ended exam of question-answer pairs from the target corpus once before optimization and reuses it across every trial, so scores stay comparable from trial to trial. Exam generation is an optional component: a user can supply a question-answer set directly, in which case the system skips generation and scores each trial on the supplied exam. When it does generate the exam, an LLM agent we call the Composer drafts the questions in three stages: it reads neighborhoods of related chunks and drafts questions from them, validation filters the drafts, and probe-based selection keeps the questions that separate one configuration from another. The Composer over-generates by a configurable factor, so the candidate pool is larger than the target exam, and validation and selection then reduce it to the requested number of questions.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架建立了一个开放式的测试 目标体的回答对一次 在优化和再利用它 在每一个试验, 所以分数 保持可比 从审判到审判。 考试生成是一个可选的组件:用户可以直接提供问答集,在这种情况下,系统跳过生成,并在提供的考试中为每个试题打分. 当它产生考试时,我们称为作曲家的LLM代理分三个阶段起草问题:它读取相关块的相邻区域,并从中起草问题;验证过滤草稿;基于探测器的选择保留将一个配置和另一个配置分开的问题. 作曲者多由可配置因子产生,因此考生池比目标考试要多,然后验证和选取再将它减少到要求的题数.

blocks.en: For each generation call the Composer reads a neighborhood of related chunks and drafts as many questions as it judges the material supports, tagging each with a question type from a fixed taxonomy of seven types (Appendix A.1 , with an example of each in A.2 ). A neighborhood pairs an anchor chunk with its same-document siblings and a set of cross-document chunks. The cross-document chunks are ranked by TF-IDF cosine similarity to the anchor, a lexical score that favors chunks sharing rare, distinctive terms with the anchor rather than common words.
blocks.zh: 对于每一代的调用,作曲家会读取一个相关块和草稿的相邻区域,与其判断材料支持时一样多的问题,从7个类型的固定分类法(Appendix A.1,在A.2中各取一例)来标记每个问题类型. 邻居们把一个锚和同一文件的兄弟姐妹 和一组交叉文件的块联系起来 交叉文档块按TF-IDF同锚的相近性排序,这个词典分数有利于块与锚分享稀有,独特的名词,而不是常见名词.

blocks.en: Each candidate passes a set of deterministic filters: a structural check that rejects a question citing one span twice rather than two distinct ones, a self-containment filter that rejects questions referring to their source by name (“the document”, “the paper”, “Chunk 1”), a non-empty-span check, and an arithmetic verification for numeric questions. Multi-hop questions then pass a sufficiency oracle. When shown all gold spans at once, the oracle must return the smallest subset of spans that supports the answer, a verbatim quote from each, and the answer itself. A question is rejected when that subset is smaller than its hop count, since it would then decompose into fewer hops. Testing the spans one at a time would misjudge sufficiency, because a single span shown alongside the question often lets the oracle infer the answer from the question itself and rate that span sufficient on its own.
blocks.zh: 每个候选人都通过一套确定性过滤器:结构检查,拒绝一个问题,引用一个跨度两次,而不是两个不同的;自我约束过滤器,拒绝提到其来源的问题(“文件”、“文件”、“Chunk 1”),非空泛检查,以及数字问题的算术核查。 多跳题后会传递出一个"足够"的预言. 当一次显示所有黄金的跨度时,甲骨文必须返回支持答案的最小的分节,每个分节的逐字引用,以及答案本身. 当子集小于其hop计数时,一个问题就会被否决,因为它会分解为更少的hop. 一次测试一个跨度会错误地判断是否足够,因为与问题一起显示的单个跨度往往让先知推断出问题本身的答案,以及一个跨度足够高的速率。

blocks.en: A question is useful to the optimizer only when some of the configurations it will evaluate solve the question and others do not. We measure this with four probe configurations that span the search-space extremes along several axes (LLM, embedding model, reranker, chunk size, and retrieved top- k k ), and we evaluate every candidate on all four. We discard the questions that every probe answers, since they no longer separate one configuration from another, favor the questions that only one or a few probes solve, and keep a small share that no probe solves, since a configuration beyond the probe envelope may still answer them. This weighting governs which questions enter the exam, not how answers are later scored.
blocks.zh: 一个问题只有在它将要评价的一些配置解决了问题而另一些则不解决的情况下,才对优化者有用. 我们用四个探测器的配置来测量它,这些配置沿着几个轴线(LLM,嵌入模型,重排,块大小,以及检索到的顶-k k)横跨搜索-空间极点,我们评价所有四个的每个候选者。 我们放弃每个探测器回答的问题, 因为它们不再将一个配置与另一个配置分开, 偏爱一个或几个探测器解决的问题, 并保留一个小份额, 没有探测器解决, 因为探测器信封以外的配置 仍然可以回答它们。 这种权重决定了哪些问题进入考试,而不是后来如何得到答案。

blocks.en: 3.3 Optimization Loop
blocks.zh: 3.3 优化循环

blocks.en: On each trial the system builds or loads a cached index for the proposed configuration, runs the RAG pipeline on every exam question, scores the answers, and records which gold spans appear in the retrieved chunks. Recording the retrieved spans is what lets the loop attribute a failure to retrieval, when the gold spans were missed, or to generation, when they were retrieved but the answer was still wrong. The trial’s outcome passes to two reasoning agents, a Diagnoser and a Proposer.
blocks.zh: 在每次试验中,系统都为提议的配置构建或加载缓存索引,在每一个考试问题上运行RAG管道,对答案进行评分,并在取回的块中记录黄金的长度。 记录取回的跨度是让回路将无法取回,当黄金跨度被错过时,或者当它们被取回但答案仍然是错误的时,记录到生成时. 审判结果由两名推理人员,一名诊断员和一名提议员决定。

blocks.en: The Diagnoser compresses the trial’s per-question evidence into a compact diagnosis, which keeps the Proposer’s context window focused on what matters. It reads a pre-computed summary of the trial that just ran: overall accuracy and accuracy on the questions where retrieval succeeded, how the failures divide between retrieval and generation, and a sample of failed questions chosen to span different failure types and question types, including questions this configuration newly got wrong, rather than only the lowest-scoring ones. It also sees a compact record of how accuracy moved across earlier trials, but not their configurations, their cost, the Pareto frontier, or its own earlier diagnoses. Withholding these keeps each diagnosis grounded in the current trial and leaves synthesis across trials to the Proposer. The Diagnoser emits a short narrative, findings tied to the trial’s numbers, notable changes from earlier trials, and a handful of illustrative questions for the Proposer. It does not prescribe configuration changes.
blocks.zh: " 诊断者 " 将审判的每个问题证据压缩成一个紧凑的诊断,从而使投标人的背景窗口专注于什么才是重要的。 它读取了刚刚运行的试题预计算摘要:检索成功的问题的整体准确性和准确性,检索失败与生成之间的分界线,以及选择跨越不同故障类型和质疑类型的失败问题样本,包括这个配置新出错的问题,而不仅仅是得分最低的问题. 它还看到关于准确性如何跨越早先的试验的简明记录,但不包括它们的配置、成本、帕雷托边疆或它自己的早期诊断。 将每个诊断都留在目前的试验中,并将各种试验的合成留给投标人。 " 诊断者 " 给出了简短的叙述、与审判人数挂钩的调查结果、与以前审判相比的显著变化以及给提议者提出的几个说明性问题。 它没有规定配置变化 。

blocks.en: The Proposer chooses the next configuration. It reads the diagnosis, the current configuration, the search space with its legal ranges, and a knowledge base of model rankings and pricing. A short plan, carried forward from one trial to the next, serves as the loop’s memory. Every configuration evaluated so far stays in view, so it never repeats one. It also knows which generators, embedding models, and rerankers remain untried, and how much of the trial budget is left. In cost-aware mode it reads the current accuracy-cost frontier directly, with each non-dominated member’s accuracy, cost, and configuration, and decides where along the cost axis to probe next. It emits the next configuration together with a rationale.
blocks.zh: 提议方选择下一个配置 。 它读取了诊断,当前配置,具有法定范围的搜索空间,以及模型排名和定价的知识基础. 一项从一次试验延续到下一次试验的短计划是循环的记忆。 迄今所评价的每个配置都保留在视野内,因此它从不重复一个. 它还知道哪些发电机,嵌入型号,以及重新排行榜仍然未经考核,还剩下多少审判预算. 在成本认识模式中,它直接读取当前准确性成本前沿,其中包含每个非主导成员的准确性、成本和配置,并决定下一步在成本轴上进行探测的地点。 它给出了下一个配置 和一个理由。

blocks.en: The knowledge base lets the Proposer rule out configurations that public benchmarks predict will underperform before a trial is spent on them. This is what makes the loop tractable in a large search space, where naive enumeration is infeasible and Bayesian baselines spend trials rediscovering the same priors. More importantly, it is what enables cost-aware search, as its per-token pricing lets the Proposer weigh accuracy against cost before each trial and move straight to cheap-but-capable generators. Appendix C details its sources and the per-model annotations the Proposer reasons over.
blocks.zh: 知识库让投标人排除了公共基准预测在审判前业绩不佳的配置。 这使得环路在大搜索空间中可以被取道,在那里天真地点数不可行,而巴耶斯基准则花去尝试重新发现相同的前作. 更重要的是,这是能够了解成本的原因,因为它的每盘价格使投标人在每次试验前能够权衡成本的准确性并直接转向廉价但有能力的发电机。 附 录 C详细列出其来源和按模型说明 投标人的理由。

blocks.en: The optimizer runs for a user-specified number of trials. In cost-aware mode it returns the Pareto frontier together with an agent-recommended configuration from it, and in score-only mode the single best-scoring configuration. Either way it also returns the per-trial reasoning trace.
blocks.zh: 优化器运行于用户指定的试验次数. 在成本感知模式下,它会连同从它得到的代理推荐配置一起返回Pareto边框,在只得分模式下,则返回单一的最佳得分配置. 无论是哪种方式,它也回溯了每审推理的痕迹。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate Agentic AutoRAG in two experiments. The first, the Accuracy experiment, maximizes answer accuracy on three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks and compares our optimizer against random search, MO-TPE with and without a warm start, and a knowledge-and-diagnosis ablation of our own agent. To compare the optimizer independently of the exam-generation component of our framework, this experiment optimizes against a fixed exam built from each benchmark’s own labeled questions rather than the corpus-derived exam of Section 3.2 . The second, the Pareto experiment, turns on the optimizer’s cost-aware mode and runs the full pipeline end to end, generating an exam from a corpus of real-world healthcare documents and then tracing the accuracy-cost Pareto frontier it finds. Every method runs under a fixed budget of 30 trials, and we repeat each search ten times with independent seeds.
blocks.zh: 我们在两次实验中评估Agenic AutoRAG. 第一种是准确性实验,在三个多跳问答基准上最大限度地提高答案精度,并将我们的优化者与随机搜索进行比较,MO-TPE与和没有温暖的起步,以及我们自己的代理人的知识和诊断衰竭. 为了独立于我们框架的考试生成部分来比较优化器,这项试验比起从每个基准本身标出的问题而不是第3.2节的官能测验而建立的固定考试进行优化。 第二,帕雷托实验开启了最优化者的成本-认识模式,并运行了整个输油管端到结束,从一系列真实世界的医疗保健文件中产生一个测试,然后追踪它发现的精确成本-帕雷托前沿。 每一种方法都在30次试验的固定预算下运行,我们用独立的种子重复了10次每次搜索.

blocks.en: The Accuracy experiment uses three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks. HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) in the distractor setting asks questions that bridge or compare two Wikipedia paragraphs. MuSiQue-Answerable ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) composes two to four single-hop questions into one, so many items need a longer reasoning chain. MultiHop-RAG ( Tang and Yang, 2024 ) draws comparison, inference, and temporal questions from a news corpus and includes unanswerable questions whose correct response is to abstain. The Pareto experiment uses the healthcare subset of UniDoc-Bench ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , 230 PDFs and 20 page images that are mostly biomedical research articles and medical studies. These documents are multi-page, with tables, figures, and mixed layouts, and we parse them with Docling ( Auer et al., 2024 ) using table-structure extraction and OCR. We use the documents as a corpus, generate the exam from them with our own pipeline, and do not use UniDoc-Bench’s labeled question-answer pairs. Table 1 reports corpus sizes.
blocks.zh: 准确性实验采用三个多跳问答基准. HotpotQA (Yang等, 2018) 在分心器设置中, 问出那些桥或比较两个维基百科段落的问题. MuSiQue - 答复 (Trivedi等,2022)将2到4个单跳题组成了1个,因此许多项目需要更长的推理链. MultiHop-RAG(Tang and Yang, 2024)从新闻资料库中提取比较,推论,以及时间问题,并包括无法回答的问题,其正确答复是弃权. 帕雷托实验使用了UniDoc-Bench(Peng等,2025年)的保健子集,230个PDF和20个页面图像,大多是生物医学研究文章和医学研究. 这些文件是多页的,有表格,数字和混合布局,我们用表格结构提取和OCR来分析它们与多克林(Auer等,2024年). 我们使用文件作为工具,用我们自己的管道进行考试,不要使用UniDoc-Bench的标签问答。 表1 报告体积。

blocks.en: All methods search the same space of pipeline configurations. It spans 2 chunking strategies over 4 chunk sizes and 4 overlaps, 13 embedding models, 2 index types with continuous retrieval depth and fusion weight, 4 query-expansion strategies, 5 reranker choices with continuous rerank depth, and 35 generator LLMs with a per-trial reasoning toggle. Appendix B lists every dimension with its range.

blocks.en: Every method sees the same search space and is scored on the same fixed exam at each trial. Random search samples configurations uniformly and resamples when a draw violates a dependency constraint. MO-TPE is the multi-objective Tree-structured Parzen Estimator from Optuna ( Akiba et al., 2019 ) that recent RAG-tuning work converges on ( Conway et al., 2025 ; Orbach et al., 2026 ) . We follow syftr ( Conway et al., 2025 ) in using it as the search engine and replicate it in our own harness with a multivariate TPE sampler. In the Accuracy experiment it optimizes answer accuracy alone, and in the Pareto experiment it optimizes accuracy and cost jointly. We do not run the full syftr system: we restrict its space to dense and hybrid pipelines, leaving out the agentic-RAG variants it also searches, disable its Pareto-frontier pruning, and run 30 trials per search rather than the several hundred syftr uses. Reduced to its search engine, MO-TPE differs from our agent only in how it chooses each configuration, so the comparison isolates the search strategy. MO-TPE (warm) additionally seeds the study with the 30 completed trials of the paired random-search run on the same corpus as a free, uncounted prior, so it draws on information from 60 evaluations while every other method sees 30. We report it at the same 30 counted trials as a strong reference. 2 2 2 This is a same-corpus warm start. It is not the cross-dataset transfer seeding of syftr, which starts a new search from Pareto-optimal flows found on different datasets. We also run an ablation of our own agent, Agentic (no KB/diag), that removes both the knowledge base and the per-question diagnosis and leaves an LLM optimizer that sees only the score trajectory and its own past configurations. The gap between it and the full agent therefore measures what the diagnosis loop and knowledge base add on top of the language model. As a non-search reference, KB Greedy takes each dimension’s top-rated option directly from the knowledge base without running any trial. Our optimizer runs in score-only mode in the Accuracy experiment and in cost-aware mode in the Pareto experiment.
blocks.zh: 每一种方法都看到同样的搜索空间,并在每次试验的同名固定考试中得分. 随机搜索样本配置统一,并当一图违反依赖性约束时再作复制. MO-TPE是来自Optuna(Akiba等,2019年)的多目标树结构Parzen估计器,最近RAG调制工作相接(Conway等,2025年;Orbach等,2026年). 我们跟随Syftr(Conway等人,2025年)使用它作为搜索引擎,并用多变的TPE采样器复制到我们的自带. 在准确性实验中,它单独优化答案精度,在帕雷托实验中,它共同优化精度和成本. 我们不运行全链路系统:我们将其空间限制在密集和混合的管线上,不使用它也搜索的代理-RAG变体,停止使用它的Pareto-frontier pruning,并且每次搜索进行30次试验,而不是几百个链路的使用。 被降低到它的搜索引擎,MO-TPE仅在它如何选择每个配置方面与我们的代理不同,因此比较隔离了搜索策略. MO-TPE(温暖)为这项研究提供了种子,完成了30项试验,对同一实体上的配对随机搜索与前作自由、未计算,因此它借鉴了60项评价中的信息,而所有其他方法都看到30项。 我们在同30起报告中将审判作为有力参考。 2,2,2 这是同一股温暖的开始。 启动从不同数据集所发现的Pareto-优化流进行新搜索的不是syftr的跨数据集传输种子. 我们还对自己的代理人Agentic(没有KB/diag)进行减速,它移除了知识基础和每个问题的诊断,留下了只看到分数轨迹和自身过去配置的LLM优化器. 因此,它与全剂之间的差距衡量诊断循环和知识基础在语言模型上增加什么。 作为非搜索参考,KB Greedy直接从知识库中取出每个维度的顶级选项,而不进行任何试验. 我们的优化器在准确性实验中运行于只得分模式,在帕雷托实验中运行于成本意识模式.

blocks.en: In the Accuracy experiment, every method is scored at each trial on a fixed 100-question validation exam built from the benchmark’s labeled questions, and each returned configuration is then re-evaluated on a separate 300-question held-out gold test set that is disjoint from the search questions and unseen during search. Both question sets are identical for every method and every seed, and the seeds vary only the optimizer’s own randomness, not the questions. Because each seed still returns its own configuration, this gives ten held-out evaluations per method, and we report the mean and standard deviation across them. For the agentic optimizer we also take its best configuration within the first 10 and 20 trials as two additional returned configurations, reported as Agentic@10 and Agentic@20. The validation exam and the held-out set are different questions, so per-trial validation scores and held-out scores are not directly comparable. On the held-out set we report exact match, token-level F1, and LLM-judge accuracy against the gold answers. We also report each method’s search cost and embedding compute in Appendix D . In the Pareto experiment we report the Pareto frontier over answer accuracy and mean per-query API cost, scored on the corpus-derived exam, which is generated once before any search and identical for every method and every seed. For each query we sum the price of its generation and query-expansion calls from LiteLLM’s model catalog and average over queries. Embedding and reranking models run locally at no API cost, so this axis is the generator-side cost, which also depends on retrieval because the retrieved passages become the generator’s input tokens.
blocks.zh: 在准确性实验中,每个方法在每次试验中都通过从基准标出的问题中建立的固定的100个问题验证考试得分,然后每个返回的配置被重新评价在单独的300个问题被搁置的黄金测试集上,这些测试与搜索问题脱节,在搜索过程中是看不见的. 两种问题集对每种方法和每种种子都是相同的,种子只有优化者自己的随机性而不同,而不是问题. 由于每个种子仍然返回自己的配置,这给出了每个方法的10个被搁置的评价,我们报告它们之间的平均和标准偏差。 对于代理优化器,我们还将其在前10和20次试验中的最佳配置作为另外两个返回配置,报告为Agentic@10和Agentic@20. 验证考试和被搁置的套数是不同的问题,因此每场验证分数和被搁置的分数并不直接可比. 在被搁置的场景上,我们报告精确的匹配度,符号级F1,以及LLM判断的准确度与黄金答案相对. 我们还报告每种方法的搜索成本,并将计算结果输入附录D。 在Pareto实验中,我们报告Pareto边框的答案精度和每克平均API成本,在命题衍生的测试中得分,该测试在任何搜索之前就产生过一次,并且对每种方法和每种种子都是一样的。 LitelLM的模型目录和平均比查询要高。 嵌入和再排位模型在没有API成本的情况下在本地运行,因此这个轴是发电机侧成本,这也依赖于取回,因为取回的通道成为了发电机的输入符.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Accuracy experiment
blocks.zh: 5.1 准确性实验

blocks.en: On all three datasets (Figure 2 ) the agentic optimizer’s best-so-far accuracy climbs fastest, reaching most of its final accuracy within the first few trials and staying at the top of every panel through the rest of the budget. Random search and cold MO-TPE climb more slowly and settle lower, and warm-started MO-TPE sits between them and the agent. The no-KB/diag ablation tracks closest to the full agent, so most of this early efficiency comes from using a language model to propose configurations. The added lift from the knowledge base and per-question diagnosis is small in the trace and shows up more clearly in the held-out numbers.
blocks.zh: 在所有三个数据集(图2)上,代理优化者最精准的精度攀升得最快,在最初的几次试验中达到其最终精度的大部分,并通过预算的其余部分停留在每个板块的顶端. 随机搜索和寒冷的MO-TPE更缓慢地攀登并更低地安顿下来,温暖起步的MO-TPE坐在他们和代理商之间. 与全代理最接近的无KB/diag活化轨迹,因此这种早期效率大多来自使用语言模型来提出配置. 知识库和每个问题诊断中增加的升降机微乎其微,更清楚地显示在被搁置的数字中。

blocks.en: On the held-out gold test set (Table 2 ) the agentic optimizer achieves higher LLM-judge accuracy than every baseline across all three benchmarks, at 0.825 on HotpotQA, 0.330 on MuSiQue, and 0.790 on MultiHop-RAG, above random search and with the two MO-TPE variants in between. Exact match and F1 tell the same story on HotpotQA and MuSiQue, where an agentic run holds the top score in every column. On MultiHop-RAG the no-KB/diag ablation matches the full agent’s exact match and F1 (0.729 and 0.748) and trails it only slightly on the judge, so the knowledge base and per-question diagnosis add little there over a plain LLM optimizer. Accuracy is low for every method on MuSiQue, whose up-to-four-hop questions need multi-step retrieval that conditions each hop on the previous hop’s results, a pipeline shape our single-round search space does not support. The low ceiling there reflects the search space rather than the optimizer, and our agent still ranks best on MuSiQue.
blocks.zh: 在被搁置的黄金测试集(表2)上,代理优化器的LLM评分精度高于所有三个基准的每个基准,在随机搜索上达到0.825分,在MuSiQue上达到0.330分,在MultiHop-RAG上达到0.790分,在二者之间达到两个MO-TPE变体。 精确匹配和F1在"热点QA"和"MuSiQue"上讲述了同样的故事,其中"代理跑"在每个栏目中占据了最高分. 在MultiHop-RAG上,无克-B/分辨的分解匹配了全剂的精确匹配和F1(0.729和0.748),并且只在评委上略微跟踪,因此知识基础和每问题诊断在简单的LLM优化器上几乎没有增加。 MuSiQue上每种方法的准确度都很低, 其高达4个跳出的问题需要多步检索, 那里的低天花板反映了搜索空间而不是优化器,我们的代理商在MuSiQue上仍然排名最出名.

Mean API cost per query on a log scale against accuracy on the self-generated exam, with each method drawn as the point-wise median across seeds of its cost-accuracy attainment (line) and the interquartile (25th to 75th percentile) spread across seeds (band). We compare our cost-aware optimizer (Agentic) against random search, cold MO-TPE, and warm-started MO-TPE.

blocks.en: 5.2 Pareto experiment
blocks.zh: 5.2 帕雷托实验

blocks.en: Figure 3 traces each method’s median cost-accuracy curve across the 10 seeds on the healthcare corpus. The agent’s median curve reaches 77% exam accuracy at $0.000741 per query. The strongest baseline, warm-started MO-TPE, peaks at 71.5% and pays $0.001284, so the agent’s best point is more accurate at 57.7% of the cost. It matches that 71.5% at $0.000288, 22.4% of what the baseline pays. It leads every baseline above $0.000236 per query. Warm MO-TPE leads only in a band from $0.000097 to $0.000236, where neither curve reaches 60% accuracy.
blocks.zh: 图3记录了每种方法的中位成本精确曲线, 代理商的中位曲线达到了77%的考试精度,每次查询0.0741美元. 最强的基线,温暖起动的MO-TPE,峰值为71.5%并支付0.001284美元,因此药剂的最佳点更准确,成本的57.7%. 它与71.5%的金额相匹配,为0.000288美元,为基准支付的22.4%。 每一次查询的基线都高于0.000236美元。 温暖的MO-TPE只在从0.000097到0.0000236的波段中领先,其中两个曲线都达到60%的精度.

blocks.en: These median-curve gaps could still come from a few lucky seeds, so we test each claim across all 10 seeds, using two-sided Mann-Whitney U tests ( Mann and Whitney, 1947 ) on per-seed quantities, Holm-corrected per family of three baseline comparisons ( Holm, 1979 ) . The higher ceiling holds: the agent’s per-seed peak exam accuracies span 74% to 82% and rank systematically above each baseline’s (Holm-corrected p = 0.017 p=0.017 against warm MO-TPE, 0.025 0.025 against cold MO-TPE, and 0.001 0.001 against random search). The low-cost match holds as well: all ten agent seeds reach warm MO-TPE’s median peak of 71.5% within their 30 trials, against five of ten warm MO-TPE seeds, four of ten cold MO-TPE seeds, and two of ten random-search seeds. When seeds are ranked by the lowest per-query cost at which they reach this accuracy, with seeds that never reach it counted as the most expensive, the agent leads every baseline (Holm-corrected p ≤ 0.001 p\leq 0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 这些中间曲线差距仍然可能来自少数幸运种子,因此我们测试所有10个种子的每个声称,使用每种子量的双侧Mann-Whitney U测试(Mann和Whitney,1947年),Holm校正每个家族三个基线比较(Holm,1979年). 更高的上限是:代理商的每种子峰值考试的速率从74%到82%,并系统地排列在每个基线之上(Holm修正后p=0.017 p=0.017 对抗温暖的MO-TPE,0.025 0.025 对抗寒冷的MO-TPE,0.001 对抗随机搜索)。 低成本的匹配也维持着:所有10个代理种子在30个试验中达到71.5%的中峰值,其中5个是10个是热的MO-TPE种子,4个是10个是冷的MO-TPE种子,2个是10个随机搜索种子。 当种子按达到这一精度的每克最低成本排名,而从未达到的种子则算作最昂贵的种子时,该剂将领导每个基准(Holm-recorded p.001 p\leq.001)。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The two experiments show the optimizer from two angles. In the Accuracy experiment, which isolates the search from cost, the agent is sample-efficient: its best configuration within the first 10 trials already matches or beats every statistical baseline’s full 30-trial held-out judge accuracy, at 0.817 against 0.786 on HotpotQA, 0.773 against 0.731 on MultiHop-RAG, and a tie on MuSiQue at 0.303 against 0.301, and the best-so-far trace (Figure 2 ) puts it near the top of every panel within the first few trials. The remaining 20 trials refine this region, and the full budget is what lets the agent match the stronger no-KB/diag ablation on MultiHop-RAG and lead on exact match and F1 on MuSiQue. The sample-efficiency reading holds even against warm-started MO-TPE, which begins with a free 30-trial same-corpus prior and so draws on information from 60 evaluations, yet is matched or beaten by the agent’s first 10 counted trials.
blocks.zh: 这两个实验从两个角度显示优化者. 在将搜索与成本隔离开的精确性实验中,代理商具有样本效率:在前10次试验中,其最佳配置已经匹配或击败了每个统计基线的全部30名被搁置法官的准确性,在热点QA上为0.817对0.786,在多霍普-RAG上为0.773对0.731,在MuSiQue上为0.303对0.301的平局,最远的跟踪(图2)使它在最初的少数试验中接近每个审判小组的顶端。 其余的20起试验改进了这个区域,而全部预算就是让特工在MultiHop-RAG上比得上更强的"无KB/diag",在准确匹配上领先,在MuSiQue上比上F1. 试样效率读取甚至可以抵挡温和起动的MO-TPE, MO-TPE开始于30个审判前,

blocks.en: The Pareto experiment is the setting we built the optimizer for, and it is a practical deployment scenario. Deploying a RAG pipeline is rarely a search for the most accurate configuration at any price. A practitioner usually wants the cheapest pipeline that clears an accuracy bar, because inference cost is paid on every query once the system is live. Our cost-aware experiment puts the agent in exactly this position, running it end to end on the real-world healthcare corpus. On this corpus the agent’s median trade-off both undercuts the baselines on cost and beats them on accuracy: it matches the strongest baseline’s median accuracy at about 22% of the cost and extends to a higher ceiling that still costs less per query than the baselines’ own best. It manages this by pricing and ranking candidates against its knowledge base before running them, so it moves directly to small but capable generators instead of spending trials to learn which cheap model suffices. Instead of a single configuration it returns the whole accuracy-cost trade-off and leaves the operating point to the user.
blocks.zh: 帕雷托实验是我们建造的优化器的设置,它是一个实用的部署方案。 部署RAG输油管很少以任何价格寻找最准确的配置. 实践者通常想要最便宜的管道来清除精度栏,因为一旦系统运行,每个查询都会支付推论费用. 我们的成本意识实验 使毒剂处于这个位置 运行它结束 在现实世界的保健。 在这个工具上,代理商的中位取舍既降低了成本基准,也降低了其准确度:它与最强基线的中位取舍率相匹配,约为成本的22 % , 并延伸到更高的上限,每一次查询的成本仍然低于基准本身的最佳成本。 它通过在运行候选人之前根据知识库对候选人进行定价和排名来管理这些候选人,因此它直接转向小型但有能力的发电机,而不是花费试验来学习哪种廉价模式足够。 它不使用单一的配置,而是返回整个精度成本取舍,并将操作点留给用户.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Agentic AutoRAG, a reasoning-driven optimizer for RAG pipelines. Instead of reducing each trial to an opaque score, it scores every configuration on a frozen corpus-derived exam, and after each trial a Diagnoser attributes each failed question to retrieval or generation while a Proposer, grounded in a knowledge base of public model rankings and pricing, selects the next configuration. On three multi-hop QA benchmarks it reaches higher LLM-judge accuracy than every baseline we compare and finds most of that accuracy within its first 10 trials. In its cost-aware mode on a healthcare corpus it reaches a median exam accuracy of 77%, above the strongest baseline’s 71.5%, at about 58% of that baseline’s cost per query, and it matches that 71.5% at about 22% of the cost.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Agentic AutoRAG,一个推理驱动的RAG管道优化器. 它不把每次试验降为不透明的分数,而是在被冻结的命题衍生考试中给每个配置评分,每次试验后,一个"诊断者"将每个失败的问题归为检索或生成,而一个以公共模型排名和定价知识库为基础的投标者则选择下一个配置. 在三个多跳QA基准上,它达到了比我们比较的每一个基准更高的LLM判断精度,并且在其前10个试验中发现了大部分的精度. 在对医疗保健机构的成本认识模式中,它达到了77%的中位考试精度,高于最强基线的71.5%,约为每一次查询中该基线成本的58%,它与71.5%的中位考试精度相匹配,约为费用的22%。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Parsing is outside the search space. Every trial parses the corpus once with Docling, caches the result, and tunes chunking and downstream stages on top of it. Reparsing on every trial would dominate per-trial wall-clock time.
blocks.zh: 解析出搜索空间外. 每一次审判都和多克林一起分析 将结果隐藏起来 并在上面调出分块和下游阶段 在每次审判上重审都会是每一次审判的时数。

blocks.en: The Proposer’s KB encodes LLM rankings from Artificial Analysis and per-token pricing from LiteLLM, neither of which is peer-reviewed. The KB is also a point-in-time snapshot. Vendors re-rank, deprecate models, and update prices over time, so the Proposer’s grounding is accurate at snapshot time and degrades with the gap to the run.
blocks.zh: 投标人的KB编码了人工分析的LLM排名和LiteLLM的平价,两者都没有经过同行审查。 KB也是一时的快照. 供应商重新排位、贬值模型,并随着时间推移更新价格,因此投标人打地时准确无误,并随着差距的缩小而下降。

blocks.en: Inference temperature is configurable, but the agent models limit reproducibility. The Composer, Diagnoser, and Proposer default to a frontier reasoning model, several reasoning models require a temperature of 1.0 to function, and hosted reasoning-model APIs do not guarantee bit-exact outputs.
blocks.zh: 推论温度可被分解出,但剂型限制了再生性. 作曲者,诊断者,和提议者默认为边框推理模型,几种推理模型需要温度为1.0才能运行,而主机推理模型API并不能保证位点精确输出.

blocks.en: Accuracy in both experiments is scored by an LLM judge, and we run no human-agreement study, so any systematic bias in the judge carries into the numbers we report.
blocks.zh: 这两个实验的准确性都是由LLM法官评分的,我们没有进行人与人之间的协议研究,因此法官中的任何系统性偏差都包含在我们报告的数字中.

blocks.en: Future Work
blocks.zh: 未来工作

blocks.en: Our exam pipeline ranks bridges by lexical TF-IDF similarity, which connects only chunks that share rare surface terms. An entity-relation graph over the corpus, as in graph-based RAG ( Edge et al., 2024 ) , would also surface bridges that share an entity but not its wording.
blocks.zh: 我们的考试管道通过词汇TF-IDF的相似性对桥梁进行排行,它只连接那些共享稀有地表名词的块. 如以图表为基础的RAG(Edge等,2024年)中,实体与实体的关系图,也可以显示一个实体的桥梁,但不包括其措辞。

blocks.en: The diagnose-then-propose loop is agnostic to what the search space contains, so it can tune richer pipeline families than the modular flow we search here. Supporting whole architectures, such as agentic RAG or graph-based RAG, would let it search across retrieval paradigms rather than within one.
blocks.zh: 诊断-当时的指针循环对搜索空间包含的内容是不可知的,因此它可以调用比我们在这里搜索的模块流更丰富的管道家族. 支持整个架构,如代理RAG或以图表为基础的RAG,将允许它在检索范式之间而不是在一个范围内搜索.

blocks.en: The optimizer weighs only accuracy and cost today, and its knowledge base already records throughput and memory, so latency or memory footprint are natural additions.
blocks.zh: 优化者今天只权衡精度和成本,其知识库已经记录了吞吐量和内存,因此耐久或内存足迹是自然的添加.

blocks.en: Each run begins cold on a new corpus. Carrying diagnoses and configuration priors across runs would let it start warm, accumulating an agent memory the optimizer retrieves from to generalize what it learns about RAG configuration from one corpus to the next.
blocks.zh: 每跑一跑 就会在新的体格上变得冷淡 随身携带诊断和配置前科会让它开始温暖,积累一个代理内存 优化器从一个实体到下一个实体中获取到的关于RAG配置的知识。

blocks.en: Appendix A Question taxonomy and exam samples
blocks.zh: 问题分类和考试样本

blocks.en: This appendix complements the exam-generation pipeline in Section 3.2 by listing the seven question types the Composer draws from and showing one representative item per type. The examples come from the 100-question exam the optimizer generated for the UniDoc healthcare corpus, the one experiment where the generated exam is the optimization target. The Accuracy experiment instead optimizes against each benchmark’s own held-in questions and generates no exam, so this appendix documents the pipeline where it runs.
blocks.zh: 本附录列出了制作人从每种类型中抽取的七个问题类型,并显示一个代表性项目,以此补充第3.2节的考试生成程序。 这些例子来自为UniDoc保健机构生成的优化器的100个问题考试,这是产生考试的一个实验,就是优化目标。 准确性实验则比照每个基准本身持有的问题进行优化,不产生考试结果,因此本附录记录它运行的管道。

blocks.en: A.1 Question types
blocks.zh: A.1 问题类型

blocks.en: The Composer assigns one type per question from a fixed taxonomy of seven question types defined a priori. The taxonomy extends the bridge and comparison split of HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) with numeric and inference variants common to multi-hop benchmarks such as MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 作曲家从7个问题类型的固定分类中为每个问题指定一个类型,定义为先验. 该分类法将HotpotQA(杨等,2018年)与多跳基准常见的数值和推论变体相桥并作比较 (Trivedi等,2022年).

blocks.en: Extraction. A factoid lookup answerable from a single span. Definitional. A short definition or description the chunk states explicitly. Numeric (single-span). Computes a value not stated verbatim by combining at least two numeric literals inside one span (sum, difference, range, median, count). Inference. Composes facts from at least two distinct spans into an answer that is not a contiguous substring (causal chain, implicit-referent resolution, qualitative direction from quantitative facts). Bridge. References an entity in one chunk via an indirect descriptor that another chunk uniquely identifies, then asks for an attribute of that entity. Comparison. Reads a comparable value from each cited chunk and returns the relation (which is larger, by how much). Numeric (multi-span). Computes across cited spans: difference, sum, ratio, duration.
blocks.zh: 提炼. 从一个角度回答事实 定义 一个简短的定义或描述,块是明确的。 数字( sing- span). 在一个跨度(和数、差数、相差数、相差数、相差数、相差数、相差数、相差数、相差数、相差数、相差数)内,将至少两个数值合并计算出一个非逐字表示的值。 推论. 将至少两个不同跨度的事实编成一个不是相接底弦的答案(因果链,隐含反射分辨,从数量上看的质量方向). 桥. 通过一个间接描述符将一个实体划入一个块,而另一个块则单独识别,然后要求该实体的属性。 比较. 从每个引用块读取一个可比较值并返回关系(大小,用多少表示)。 数值 (多相). 跨引用跨度的计算:相差,相和,相比,相长.

blocks.en: A factoid lookup answerable from a single span.

blocks.en: Both numeric types also carry an arithmetic formula. The Composer must supply it alongside the answer, and the validator rejects the question when the formula does not evaluate to the canonical answer. This guards against arithmetic mistakes by the Composer LLM.
blocks.zh: 两种数字类型都带有算术公式. 作曲家必须同时提供答案,当公式不评价到犬类答案时,验证者拒绝这个问题. 防止编曲LLM的计算错误。

blocks.en: Each source span is the minimal excerpt the answer strictly depends on, usually a single sentence. A span carries none of the surrounding context, so the example spans below can be hard to read on their own. Each records only the exact text a pipeline must retrieve, not the context that explains the answer. Retrieval counts as successful for a question only when the retrieved chunks contain all of its spans, and the per-question diagnosis uses this test to attribute a failure to weak retrieval rather than weak generation.
blocks.zh: 每个来源的跨度是答案严格依赖的最小节选,通常为一句. 一个跨度不包含任何周边上下文,因此下面的示例跨度可能很难单独阅读. 每个文件只记录管道必须检索的确切文本,而不是解释答案的背景。 检索只有在检索到的块包含其所有跨度时才算成问题的成功,每问题诊断使用这个测试来将失败归于弱检索而不是弱生成.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the type distribution of the 100 questions that survive validation and probe-based selection on UniDoc. Extraction is well represented (16): the documents state many specific facts buried in long, multi-section text that are not trivially retrievable. Definitional questions do not survive selection, and only one single-span numeric question does, because most numeric reasoning here combines values that sit in different spans. The exam also stays within documents: 98 questions keep all their spans within one document, and only 2 cross into a second.

blocks.en: Inference Question. Why does the commercial Indian antivenom show limited efficacy against the newly discovered krait species from Southern India? Answer. Antivenom is manufactured from B. caeruleus venom, not from the new species (variant: “because it is made from B. caeruleus venom”). blocks.en: The search space is one of the inputs the user supplies to the optimizer, alongside the corpus. It is a single YAML file (Listing 1 ) that names the corpus, the models that drive the optimizer, the exam-generation settings, and the dimensions to search. The optimizer reads this file directly, so the search space is fully specified and auditable before any trial runs.
blocks.zh: 搜索空间是用户向优化器提供的投入之一,与本体并列. 它是一个单一的YAML文件(Listing 1),它命名了本体,驱动优化器的模型,考试生成设置,以及搜索的维度. 优化者直接读取此文件,因此在任何试运行前,搜索空间是完全指定的并可以审计的.

blocks.en: Listing 1 shows the configuration for the Pareto experiment on UniDoc, where the optimizer generates and scores its own exam. The Accuracy experiment, on HotpotQA, MuSiQue, and MultiHop-RAG, shares the same search_space and differs only in its exam source, cost mode, and parsing, each described below. Those runs supply each benchmark’s own held-in questions as the validation exam through examiner.custom_exam_path and generate none, so the examiner block in the listing does not apply to them. They also run score-only rather than cost-aware, and they parse pre-extracted text with OCR and table-structure extraction off. blocks.en: Appendix B names the candidate models. This appendix shows the annotations the Proposer reasons over for each one. The knowledge base pairs every model in the search space with public benchmark scores, per-token pricing, and serving attributes, which lets the Proposer rank candidates and rule out quality-cost-dominated choices before it spends a trial on them. LLM benchmarks and throughput come from Artificial Analysis, 3 3 3 https://artificialanalysis.ai/ embedding and reranker rankings from the MTEB ( Muennighoff et al., 2023 ) , MMTEB ( Enevoldsen et al., 2025 ) , and FollowIR ( Weller et al., 2025 ) benchmarks, and per-token pricing from LiteLLM. 4 4 4 https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm The optimizer renders the knowledge base filtered to the configured search space and to the run’s reasoning-effort setting, so a model that supports reasoning can appear as two entries, one reasoning and one non-reasoning, with different scores. The 35 generator models of Appendix B therefore render as 49 scored entries.
blocks.zh: 附 录 B命名候选模特. 本附录列出每个提案人的理由说明。 知识库将搜索空间中的每个模型都配以公共基准分数,每个标价,以及服务属性,这使得投标人可以排出候选人的排行榜,排除以质量成本为主的选择,然后再对他们进行试验. LLM基准和吞吐量来自人工分析,3 3 3 https://artificialanalysis.ai/ 从MTEB(Muennighoff等,2023年),MMTEB(Enevoldsen等,2025年)和FollowIR( Weller等,2025年)基准,以及从LiteLM. 4 4 https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm得出的价格。 优化器将知识库过滤到配置的搜索空间和运行的推理-努力设置,因此支持推理的模型可以作为两个条目出现,一个是推理,一个是非推理,分数不同. 因此,附录B的35个发电机模型使49个有分数的条目成型。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Search cost and embedding compute on the three datasets of the Accuracy experiment. Bars show the mean over the 10 search seeds and whiskers span ± 1 \pm 1 standard deviation across seeds. In the search-cost panel each bar splits into optimizer reasoning (the agent’s Proposer and Diagnoser calls) and trial evaluation (the RAG generation and judge scoring at each trial). Random search and MO-TPE propose configurations without a language model, so their cost is entirely trial evaluation. The embedding panel counts embedding-input tokens in millions, one charge per distinct embedder and chunk-size configuration rather than per trial.

blocks.en: Figure C reports two costs of running each optimizer on the three datasets of the Accuracy experiment, the dollar cost of the search and the embedding compute it consumes. We count the latter as embedding-input tokens, charged once per distinct embedder and chunk-size configuration, since each index is built once and reused across a run’s trials. Bars are the mean over the 10 search seeds and whiskers span ± 1 \pm 1 standard deviation across seeds. The methods differ most on embedding tokens used. The agent’s search consumes 11 to 16M embedding tokens per dataset, against 46 to 79M for random search and 34 to 63M for MO-TPE, three to five times fewer. Guided by the knowledge base, it settles on a few strong embedders early and reuses their cached indexes, while random search and MO-TPE sample embedders and chunk sizes across the whole space and pay for a fresh index build on each new combination.
blocks.zh: 图 C在精确度实验的三个数据集上报告每个优化器运行的两个成本,搜索的美元成本和它所消耗的嵌入计算. 我们把后者算作嵌入符,每一次按不同的嵌入器和块大小的配置充电,因为每个指数都是一次建立,并在运行的试验中重复使用。 杠是10个搜索种子的平均值,而胡子横跨种子的标准差为±1\pm 1。 在使用的嵌入符上,方法差异最大. 代理搜索每个数据集消耗了11到16M嵌入符,随机搜索则消耗了46到79M,而MO-TPE则消耗了34到63M,是3到5倍. 在知识库的指导下,它很早就在几个坚固的嵌入器上安顿下来并重新使用其缓存索引,而随机搜索和MO-TPE样本则在整个空间上嵌入并块大小并支付一个以每个新组合为基础的新指数.

blocks.en: In dollars the methods are closer, and the full 30-trial agent costs more than the statistical baselines. The gap is trial evaluation, not reasoning. Its Proposer and Diagnoser calls add only $0.71 to $0.79 per run, while random search and MO-TPE choose configurations without a language model and spend nothing on reasoning. What raises the agent’s bill is the pipelines it evaluates. These are score-only runs, so cost is not an objective and nothing steers the agent toward cheaper generators. It knows from the knowledge base and the language model’s own priors which generators are strong, and strong generators tend to cost more per token, so its trials favor more capable, more expensive configurations. However, reaching their accuracy does not take the full budget. Its 10-trial checkpoint recovers most of the agent’s final held-out accuracy (Table 2 ) at $1.48 to $2.92 per run, comparable to random search and MO-TPE at $1.86 to $4.45.
blocks.zh: 以美元计算的方法更为接近,30名审判代理人的全部费用高于统计基线。 差距在于试验评价,而非推理. 它的出价和诊断器的调用每跑只增加0.71到0.79美元,而随机搜索和MO-TPE则选择没有语言模型的配置,不花什么去推理. 开具代理账单的是其评估的管道。 这些是只得分的跑步,所以成本并不是一个目标,没有任何东西能引导毒剂转向更便宜的发电机. 它从知识基础和语言模型自身的前科中知道什么是强力发电机,而强力发电机往往每件象征性地花费更多,因此它的试验倾向于更能,更昂贵的配置. 然而,达到其准确性并不需要全额预算。 其10个审判检查站恢复了特工最后扣留的准确性(表2),每跑1.48至2.92美元,相当于随机搜查和MO-TPE1.86至4.45美元。
